scientific_integrity: A deductive componentwise proof and a uniform c.e.-degree construction are included. No independent audit or external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The structural theorem assumes both in-degree and out-degree at most one.
The effective degree-spectrum statement assumes computable partial predecessor and successor functions.
No claim is made for grounding ordinals above omega or for higher-degree frameworks.
The path-based c.e.-degree witness is related to existing tree-to-argumentation encodings; global priority is not claimed.
title: Grounded semantics of degree-one argumentation graphs: exact stages and degree spectrum
